title: We've built a website for quick and easy playtesting/rating for games built with AI.
author: the_badget
selftext:
[playtest.win](https://www.playtest.win/) is a website where you can quickly list your game (can be as simple as pasting a link to your game's page) and have people try it out and provide feedback. No payments, no subscriptions, no ads. It's oriented specifically towards the developers/players in this community.

The goal was to make the process as simple as possible for both the dev and the player, but still gather meaningful inputs about the game and help iterate. The default rating system is "the quadrants" where with a single click one can provide ratings for both gameplay and visuals. Developers can optionally request additional info - also single click inputs.

We also tried to close the feedback loop and allow developers to thank everyone who played their game and even specifically recognize those whose comments led directly to changes in subsequent versions.

Check it out. Have fun and help each other.
